name: Services for NYCHA Residents Local Law 163
description:
This dataset catalogs social services available to New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) residents. Each row represents a program and includes its name, service category (such as employment-related programs, financial counseling or banking services, civil service exams, or small business assistance), the city agency that provides it (for example, Small Business Services, the Department of Consumer Affairs, the Department of Social Services, or NYCHA itself), a short description of the service, and the geographic unit it covers—either a borough, a NYCHA development, or a City Council district. The sample contains 26 rows with no missing values across the five columns.

The data can be used by residents, caseworkers, and outreach staff to identify and refer people to relevant programs, and by analysts to compare which agencies and service categories are represented across different geographic areas. It also supports reporting on the range of municipal services offered to public housing residents.
